meta.note: The places on the family map, one dataset for the whole site. Started as the address directory of 25 November 2026, brought up to date with main after pull requests 19 to 21, and checked place by place on 26 November 2026. Every place has coordinates and a coordinate source. A place whose street or building could not be found today is drawn as a circle over the town the record names, and its coordinateMethod says so.
meta.recordCropsNote: The engine looks for record crops in images/records/. This site keeps its record images in images/, so each crop is written ../file.jpg, which the browser reads as images/file.jpg.

places.significance: The comune where the Circelli and Belfiore lines were born, married, and registered in the stato civile.
places.blurb: A town story, with no proven family link. In April 1884 a bugler of the 19th Infantry from San Bartolomeo, Bartolomeo Circelli, stopped a soldier named Misdea in the Pizzofalcone barracks in Naples and was awarded a medal for it. He was clubbed to death in a street fight back home in February 1885. Whether he belonged to our Circelli families is not known.

places.name: Vico Passaro (reading uncertain), San Bartolomeo in Galdo
places.address: no. 17, Vico Passaro (reading uncertain), San Bartolomeo in Galdo
places.coordinateMethod: Photon (OpenStreetMap data) on 2026-11-26. Search: Vico Passaro, San Bartolomeo in Galdo. Result: Vico Passaro, a stepped lane in the old town. The house number 17 is not placed, so the circle covers the lane.
places.todayNote: A lane called Vico Passaro still climbs through the old town on today's map. That supports the reading of the street name on the 1884 birth act, though the house itself has not been found.
places.significance: The house where Michael was born in December 1884, at no. 17 of a lane whose name reads like Vico Passaro.

events.summary: Born. No. 17, Vico Passaro (reading uncertain), San Bartolomeo in Galdo
events.note: Birth act 440 of 1884 gives 15 December 1884; the index line agrees. His WWI card and death certificate say 1885 and his WWII card says 1883. The street name is hard to read on the scan, and Passaro is the best reading.
